name: What steps does your company take to remove a musty smell?

mainEntity.name: What steps does your company take to remove a musty smell?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with a thorough inspection to identify the source of the musty smell and assess the extent of mold growth and moisture. We then implement containment measures to prevent cross-contamination. This is followed by source elimination (fixing leaks, drying), mold removal using specialized equipment and cleaning agents, and often include replacing heavily damaged materials. Finally, we conduct post-remediation verification and apply preventative treatments to inhibit future growth, ensuring your home is clean and odor-free.
acceptedAnswer.description: We inspect, contain, eliminate moisture, remove mold, replace damaged materials, and verify cleanup to remove musty smells.
